A page is an `.mdx` file under `src/content/docs`. Its path is its address:
`guides/writing-pages.mdx` is served at `/guides/writing-pages`, and an
`index.mdx` at its folder's address.

## Frontmatter

| Field | What it says |
| --- | --- |
| `title`, `description` | The page's h1 and lead, its `<title>` and its meta description. |
| `sidebarTitle` | A shorter title for the sidebar. |
| `icon` | One of the icons `docs.config.ts` declares. |
| `audience` | Who the page is for: one or more of the audiences in `docs.config.ts`. |
| `kind` | `guide` (one task), `reference` (rules and lists), `explanation`, or `path`. |
| `stage` | The moment of the reader's journey, from `docs.config.ts`. |
| `prerequisites`, `next` | Slugs of the pages to read before and after, shown around the content. |
| `sources`, `lastVerified` | The external pages a procedure was checked against, and when. |

A typo in the frontmatter fails the build and names the file.

## Components

Every page can use these without importing them:

<CodeGroup>
```mdx title="Callouts"
<Note>Something worth knowing.</Note>
<Tip>A shortcut.</Tip>
<Warning>Something that can go wrong.</Warning>
```

```mdx title="Cards"
<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Quickstart" icon="rocket" href="/guides/quickstart" />
</CardGroup>
```
</CodeGroup>

There are also `Steps`, `Tabs`, `Accordion` and `Screenshot`.

<Warning>
  A link to a page that does not exist fails `bun run test`.
</Warning>

## The sidebar

`src/content/docs/navigation.ts` lists every page by its slug, in tabs and
groups. A page it does not list, or lists twice, fails the test.
